title: trailboss --json live --board
description: The agents running now, grouped by state, as `live --board` shows them. Takes the same --pin, --unpin, --settle, --unsettle, --quiet and --unquiet as `live`, made before the board is printed. --all shows the agents at rest for over an hour in their groups instead of folding them.

groups.description: Every state, in this order, even with no rows: needs_you, working, done, idle, failed, stopped. more may be added. needs_you: waiting for the person (status blocked, waiting, needs_input or permission), or at rest with a reason it waits on you (`needs`: a question, a plan, a command to approve, a reply that asked something), or spinning, working or not (`needs_kind` same_error, same_call, stopped_short, quiet_subagent or still_failing, as on `live`). working: status working or busy. done: status done. idle: any other status of a running agent (idle, running, unknown). failed: its last turn ended on an error or a rate limit (`needs_kind` error or rate_limit), or status failed or error. stopped: a terminal whose agent is gone (no `agent`). A quiet agent's finished turn (done) and its question or reply show as idle. Within a group, pinned rows first, then as `live` found them.

items.description: A `live` row (see live), plus its sub-agents at work.

needs.description: What it waits for, in at most about 40 characters (as on `live`): on a needs_you row, the question, the command to approve, the plan.

subagents.description: Rows it started that are at work (in the working state) and not settled or folded, each a row like this one, with its own `subagents`. They aren't listed again in the working group. A sub-agent in any other state is a row of its own group, with `parent`.

folded.description: Agents at rest (done or idle) for over an hour by `status_since`, not pinned and not settled: the text table shows them as one "+N at rest" line. Empty with --all.

items.description: A `live` row (see live), as `live` prints it.

settled.description: Agents settled with `live --settle` and not yet back: they aren't on the board. One comes back on its own, its settle cleared, when it needs you (a question, an approval, an error), finishes or starts a turn (a message typed into it), or exits; a quiet agent's finished turns and questions don't bring it back. `live --unsettle` brings one back by hand.

items.description: A `live` row (see live), as `live` prints it.
